description: The claims the agent eval suites must prove. A case names its claims as `claim` (routing, roles) or a `claim:` tag (plugin, team), and `tests/test_eval_coverage.py` holds them to this file. Every action in schemas/risks.json and a `route:` claim for every area in it are required too, so this file lists only the other claims. `known_gaps` lists a required claim no case covers yet, with why; it only shrinks, so a case that closes a gap removes it here.
